item.title: Three requests filed to disqualify Ra’am from running in elections
item.description:
The Central Elections Committee will consider next week requests to disqualify lists and candidates from running in the elections to the 26th Knesset.
Three requests have been filed to disqualify the Ra’am party, two requests to disqualify Otzma Yehudit, one request to disqualify the Democrats party, one request to disqualify the Religious Zionist Party, one request to disqualify the Joint List and MK Ofer Cassif, and another request to disqualify former MK Sami Abu Shehadeh.

item.title: Otzma Yehudit demands disqualification of Sami Abu Shehadeh
item.description: The Otzma Yehudit party petitions the Central Elections Committee to disqualify former MK Sami Abu Shehadeh from running in the upcoming Knesset elections.

item.title: Reports: Two strikes carried out in southern Lebanon
item.description: According to reports in Lebanon, two strikes were carried out in the Al-Qantara area of southern Lebanon.

item.title: Reports in Iran: Several explosions heard near Qeshm Island
item.description: According to reports in Iran, several explosions were heard near Qeshm Island, located close to the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Vance: US-Iran war will enter 'much different phase' within months
item.description: Vice President JD Vance says the US-Iran conflict will enter a “much different phase" within months as Washington pressures Tehran and restores traffic through Hormuz.

item.title: Bereaved families, B'Tsalmo organization file petition to disqualify MK Ofer Cassif
item.description:
Dozens of bereaved families and the B'Tsalmo organization have submitted a petition to the Central Elections Committee seeking to disqualify MK Ofer Cassif of the Joint List from running in the elections for the 26th Knesset.
Adv. Eldad Rabinowitz, a member of the Central Elections Committee representing the Noam party, joined the petition and is also representing the petitioners alongside Adv. Yehuda Pua.

item.title: Chilling | Keshet Casarotti’s last call on October 7
item.description: In the recording, Keshet can be heard trying to call for medical assistance, describing the severe pain he was suffering and the paralyzing fear that left him unable to move.

item.title: Katz: We eliminate terrorists, remove threats, and do not target civilians or uninvolved people
item.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the IDF and Shin Bet elimination of the Rafah Brigade commander in southern Gaza.
“The policy that the Prime Minister and I are leading, and that the IDF is carrying out in the most professional and appropriate manner, is clear: We eliminate terrorists and remove threats, and we do not target civilians or uninvolved people - contrary to the blood libel fabricated by the makers of the film ‘NAZA,’ directed against our heroic soldiers. No terrorist is immune, and Hamas will not remain in Gaza," Katz said.

item.title: Rom Braslavski: I’m afraid a Palestinian government will be established here
item.description: Captivity survivor Rom Braslavski spoke with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and admitted that despite their disagreements, he is very apprehensive about giving his vote to the left.

item.description: What does it mean, to remember not to forget? In Judaism, the paradox of “remembering not to forget" is anchored in the dual command regarding the biblical nation of Amalek.

item.description: In standing up to Macklemore and declaring, “I was born a Jew," Pink did something painfully rare in today’s entertainment world: she refused to abandon her people when supporting Jews became unfashionable.

item.description: The Consumer Price Index rose 0.7% in August, bringing annual inflation to 1.5%, while rents continued to climb and home prices fell 1.2% year-on-year.

item.title: Islamic Jihad commander who infiltrated Kissufim on 10/7 eliminated
item.description:
Last weekend the IDF struck in the Khan Younis area in the southern Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Mohsen Farid Said Abu Hadaf, a rocket cell commander in the Islamic Jihad terrorist organization.
The terrorist infiltrated Kissufim area during the October 7th Massacre.
Recently, the terrorist advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.
The IDF stated that prior to the strike, measures were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance.

item.description: Bereaved families, relatives of hostages and captivity survivors presented the “October 7 File," a document they say compiles facts about the policies and decisions that preceded the massacre.

item.title: Commander of Hamas Jabaliya Battalian eliminated
item.description:
Overnight (Monday), the IDF and ISA struck in the northern Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Ahmad Batash, commander of the Jabaliya Battalion in the Northern Gaza Brigade of Hamas’ military wing.
As part of his role, the terrorist was responsible for managing and organizing the Northern Gaza Brigade’s weapons and coordinated and facilitated the supply of weapons and military equipment to Hamas operatives.
Recently, the terrorist advanced terrorist attacks targeting IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire.
The terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.
The IDF ststed that prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precision munitions and aerial surveillance.
